findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Procurement.Limits.pettyCashCeiling matches no observation and cites no authority: decimal literal 250.00 (line 6). Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Procurement.Rules.priceTolerance matches no observation and cites no authority: decimal literal 0.04 (line 8). Value 0.04 equals DEC-PR05.p1 (superseded by DEC-PR07). The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Accounts Payable: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Procurement.Rules.paymentTermsDays matches no observation and cites no authority: 'match' branch (line 22); wildcard default returning 35 for unlisted cases (line 24). A wildcard default silently decides every unlisted case; no record authorizes that default. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
